description: firmware provider: ESP-IDF pin and peripheral header and sdkconfig.defaults for ESP32-C3 modules, every setting citing the UHD facts it comes from.

skills.summary: SOP: configure ESP-IDF for a UHD board with an ESP32-C3 module (firmware capability): config, generate, check, export, hand-off; strapping pins and Deep-sleep wake checked

capabilities.summary: ESP-IDF 5.3 board_pins.h (buses, addresses, buttons, controls, wake mask) and sdkconfig.defaults (target, flash, console, RTC clock) for an ESP32-C3 board

generate.summary: Read the board into a firmware map, apply the rules, write board_pins.h and sdkconfig.defaults under esp-idf/ with the line index

export.summary: Copy the generated files to out/config/ and write out/firmware.manifest.json (refuses files edited since generate)

extract.summary: Artifact references and the GPIOs the header names

check.summary: Pin table, single use, bus functions, I2C addresses, strapping pins, Deep-sleep wake sources, controller counts, and drift between the files and the board

controller.description: instance path of the controller, when the board has more than one microcontroller

console.description: usb (USB Serial/JTAG; default when GPIO18/19 are wired) or uart0

i2c_frequency_hz.description: I2C bus clock (default: the slowest device's limit, 400 kHz at most)

uart_baud.description: { <instance>: baud } for UART devices that state no baud_rate

wake.description: [<button or device instance | net>] inputs that wake the chip from Deep-sleep; each must be on an RTC GPIO (GPIO0-5)
